hero.title: Front-end developer with passion
hero.intro: I have a passion for front-end web development. I have worked for more than 10 years with website development — the first 5 years as a hobby alongside school. The last 5 years I have focused on going full professional into web development.

about.title: Photographer & Fullstack Developer - Felix A. Schultz
about.body: I'm Felix A. Schultz and work in the crossover between the visual and the technical. As a photographer it's the moment that drives me - not the staged, but the real one. At festivals and events I look for the small moments that most people miss: an emotion in the audience, a glance between two people, the atmosphere in the room. At smaller photoshoots it's about creating a space where the natural can come to life.
